sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 260. Deal magic damage (Star) 5 times that penetrates damage reduction and damage reflection effects with a success value of 100.
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Applies Frail for 40 seconds with a success value of 100.
-Target: yourself. Applies Ambush for 60 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; [Special] increases DEF and MDEF by 100%; reduces the cooldown time of Abilities to 0 (except for certain Abilities); nullifies Cost reduction and Unison gauge reduction. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).
-Applies Dark Inhibitor (prevents dark Unison Attacks and dark Great Spirit Unison Attacks from activating, decreases all stats by 30%, and increases Ability Power of damage taken by 30) to the enemy Field for 90 seconds.
Star elemental defense boosted by 200 when equipped in the Main Slot.
